title: Love Song of Night and Day

entities.name: The Love Song of Night and Day
aliases: Love Song of Night and Day
entities.description: A poem from Jamuraa telling of the love between night and day and their separation, told through the flavor text of seventeen cards in Mirage and Visions.

entities.name: Night
entities.description: The male speaker of the poem, who works in darkness collecting stars and loves Day.

entities.name: Day
entities.description: The female speaker of the poem, a woman who works only while it is light and loves Night.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the poem originates and over which the lovers' tears spill.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Jamuraa lies.

entities.name: Daraja Plains
entities.description: Grasslands where leopards hang from trees, near villages of tree-dwelling elves, walked by the lovers on their last day together.

entities.name: Time Stopped
entities.description: An occasion on which, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Day stood still, letting Night hold her.

events.summary: The lovers invite each other to a festival and trade stories, promises and gifts before their parting.
events.quote: Run with me to the festival, where we will dance until sunrise.

events.summary: Day declares they will eat a farewell feast, marking the coming separation.
events.quote: Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast.

events.summary: On their last day together the lovers walk across the Daraja Plains, seeing everything as children.
events.quote: On this our last day together, let us walk across the grasslands.

events.summary: Day recalls herding sheep with Night as children and his stories at evening.
events.quote: Even then my heart was yours.

events.summary: Night remembers Day's sacred rites, from which she returned a warrior with a tattooed eye.
events.quote: You went in a girl, but you returned a warrior.

events.summary: Day announces she must leave tomorrow to war, promising to return and telling Night to wait for her.
events.quote: Tomorrow I must go, my love.

events.summary: Day tells of Day and Night, who glimpse each other only at dawn and dusk and whose tears wash Jamuraa red.
Once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Night wrapped Day in his cloak and the two became as One, until Night was pulled away by the western horizon.
events.quote: In their miraculous embrace, the two became as One.

events.summary: Day concludes that they must live apart, only glimpsing each other across the sky, because neither can change.
events.quote: I'll live my life apart from you, just glimpsing you across the sky

relations.quote: Day loves Night, who works in darkness

relations.source: The Love Song of Night and Day
relations.quote: is a poem from Jamuraa , Dominaria .
